title: BLESSED ARE THOSE WHO MOURN
theme: Mourning sin leads to repentance and the comfort of God’s forgiveness.
proposition: Understanding the importance of Mourning our Sin (in Repentance), the sins of others (in Reproach), and the comfort that comes from God, through forgiveness (Remission of Sins).
sermonQuestion: How does mourning over sin lead to God’s promised comfort?
